scenes.say: Why do cloud data platforms split storage and compute? What’s the real benefit?

scenes.label: Storage
scenes.sub: Stores your data safely and permanently.
scenes.say: Storage keeps your data safe and permanent, even when nothing is running.

scenes.label: Compute
scenes.sub: Runs queries and transformations on demand.
scenes.say: Compute is what runs your queries and transformations, only when you need it.
In the past, storage and compute were stuck together. Now, you can scale each one separately and pause compute without losing your data.

scenes.title: Resize or pause compute
scenes.say: In Snowflake, you can pause or resize your compute warehouse, while your data stays safe in cloud storage.

scenes.question: What happens to data if compute pauses?
scenes.wrong: Data is lost until compute resumes.
scenes.right: Data stays safe in storage, even if compute is paused.
scenes.say: Interview trap: What happens to your data if compute is paused? The answer: your data stays safe in storage, no matter what.
